at_sea:
VOYAGE CLOSED, PROVED and pushed: ticket a-non-final-answer-is-refused-by-name (cairn 4078463, commons 5782ee3). host.py's _post now refuses ollama's non-final frame by name — HostNonFinal — instead of letting it walk three checks and die at metered_cost talking about token counters. The predicate is `"done" in body and body["done"] is not True`: PRESENT and not true, because real /api/embed responses carry no `done` key at all and the obvious `body.get("done") is not True` would refuse every embedding this system takes. The regression tooth that stands between the two forms was written first, was green on HEAD, and its whole value is that it stayed green after.

Order was evidence-before-assertion, deliberately inverting cheap-first: HEAD already raised on the 96-byte frame, so a tooth asserting merely 'some error' would be green on a codebase with no fix in it. The discriminating tooth asserts the TYPE and was measured RED on HEAD through _refuses' wrong-type branch. 31 teeth green twice, sealed under netns; charter falsifier gained clause (9); lab recompiled.

LIVE, through the real resolver: cold hex (unload, /api/ps [], num_ctx 81920) 4 asks -> 4 HostNonFinal carrying the frame verbatim; warm 8 asks -> 8 answers at cost 17; plus 9 asks at default options, all answered. The guard has never bitten a good answer.

CAST AND FILED, found at build time: a-refused-ask-leaves-a-row. domain.resolve() writes the inference_calls row only AFTER resolver(request) returns, so a raise leaves NO ROW — 2520 rows in the corpus, zero for any ask that failed. The domain's 'ask record' is an answer record wearing an ask record's name.

When it lands, the probe a_non_final_answer_is_refused_by_name.py can have its enough strengthened from 'the fault has not returned' to 'the guard has fired N times and never on a good answer'.

THE CORRECTION THAT MATTERS MOST, because it falsifies something this repo already recorded: 'num_ctx is NOT the discriminator' was measured WARM, which is the wrong condition. The frame needs COLD LOAD *AND* a large num_ctx (81920). Cold with the resolver's default options answers in ~2s and does not reproduce it; 'ps empty' is not the discriminator either (unload, poll /api/ps to [], ask with default options -> answered at 1.9s). Same family as the timeout story this ticket was born to correct: a measurement taken under the wrong condition standing in for the one that matters. Corrected in the ticket's distinctions and the PROVED note; NOT yet corrected wherever the warm claim was first written down (slate 2026-08-18 line, dc10cfa's commit message) — those are records of truth and the amend lane is the thing that does not exist yet, which is the same hole trouble a-clear-carries-a-false-statement... has been naming at count 3.

AND I MISLABELLED MY OWN CONTROL MID-VOYAGE, caught in flight: called a still-loading host 'warm' on elapsed wall-clock and read 8 refusals as 8 answers. The method changed — warmth is now established by OBSERVATION (retry until an ask actually answers), never by a clock. Worth keeping because the first version LOOKED like a clean control.

TWO AUTHORED CHART EXPECTATIONS THAT MEASUREMENT FALSIFIED, both dispositioned inside the verdict rather than quietly dropped: (a) hypothesize placed the predicate 'before the not-a-dict guard's successors' — it sits AFTER that guard and must, because it subscripts body; the behavioural half held exactly, the positional half was written before the code was read. (b) validate's criterion 3 claimed the seal would take inference_domain 'from 5 green validations to 6' — false, the validation store keeps ONE CURRENT RECORD PER PROOF (ticket a-validation-is-one-current-record-not-a-trail), so the seal REPLACED test_host.json's 2026-08-17 record and the count is 5 before and after.

PHYSICS THAT WORKED WITHOUT BEING PLANNED FOR, worth noting as a pass: arming the probe changed the component's source fingerprint after test_host.py had been sealed, and clearance.clear REFUSED the PROVED crossing onto code that had moved under its proof (449077209f18 -> 86c7b5b41a30). Re-sealed, then cleared. The gate supplied that, not me.

TOOL-CALL COUNT, /sail step 9's first measurement and still a hand's act — nothing counts them: roughly 60 across the voyage, LABELLED AS AN ESTIMATE because the session compacted mid-build and I am counting from memory of the shape rather than from a record. That is itself the finding: the number that is supposed to score the chart cannot be read back, which is what ticket the-builds-tool-calls-are-evidence-about-the-chart is for.
